name: wxBTRFLY
classificationNote: Classified by keyword rules from the SlowMist label and description.
rootCause: White hat hackers at @immunefi discovered a critical vulnerability in the wxBTRFLY Token contract. The transferFrom function in the contract did not update the recipient's authorization correctly, and would incorrectly update the msg.sender's authorization. Although the vulnerability itself is serious, the cause is not complicated (more like a clerical error produced by the developer). What is more interesting is the official repair method. Since the contract itself does not support upgrade, the contract code cannot be updated directly; the contract does not support suspension, so it is not possible to transfer user assets by means of snapshot + migration.…
